blocks.text: Statistics riyazi ki woh shaakh hai jo data samajhne aur jaanchne mein madad deti hai, bari maloomat ko saadgi se khulasa kar ke nateeje nikalna aasan banati hai. Is ke bunyadi khayalat descriptive statistics, markazi rujhan (central tendency) ke paimane, phailao (dispersion) ke paimane aur imkan (probability) hain.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke chaar bunyadi statistical tasawwurat bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Descriptive statistics, central tendency ke paimane, dispersion ke paimane aur probability.

items: Statistics data ka khulasa karti hai: descriptive statistics, central tendency, dispersion, probability.
